title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1510: Normally abnormal (3)

section.p: “I’m so strong!”

Su Yu sighed at how strong he was becoming. He had benefited significantly from his trip to the Luminous Domain Mansion. Then again, a lot of trouble was also waiting for him outside. But he could no longer be bothered about his so-called trouble.
He glanced at Bai Feng and the others. They were still cultivating. Thus, he did not disturb them and took his Mark of Civilization. He started storing a large amount of blood into the book.

He had killed a lot of people in the mansion. He had not been able to gather too many corpses, but he had gained a decent amount of blood essence. He had also gained some heaven weapons and Invincible blood essence.

There was no need to keep those things on him. Those things could very well be used to track his location. Thus, he decided to feed those things to his Mark of Civilization. Slowly, more and more golden stripes appeared on the book.
113 stripes, 114 stripes…
By the time Su Yu started feeding it with Invincible blood essence, the book shook.
118 golden stripes.
After absorbing countless blood essence, the Mark of Civilization had finally advanced into a middle-stage heaven weapon. Yun Chen and Lan Tian merely watched silently. Su Yu…was truly a freak.
And Su Yu wasn’t stopping yet. Next, he took six heaven weapons out.
With an odd expression, he said, “Please lend me a hand. I wish to shatter these weapons and merge them with my Mark of Civilization.”
Both Yun Chen and Lan Tian stared at him blankly.
Holy shit!
What a crazy guy.
“Are you sure?”
Yun Chen asked, “As a weaponsmith, you should be able to remove what you don’t need from these heaven weapons…”
“Nope.” Su Yu grinned, “Heaven weapons? Carrier treasures? Nothing is as reliable as my own strength. When I’m strong enough, I can get anything I want.”

He continued, “Please help me, Seniors. My weapon can stop at the middle heaven grade, but I can keep upgrading the individual pages. I intend to fuse one heaven weapon into each page. I also have a lot of carrier treasures left. I plan to fuse them all into my pages as well.

“I am now strong enough to control a stronger weapon. It would be even better if I can push each individual page to the heaven grade and the main book into the divine grade. Just imagine a weapon like that. How terrifying would it be?”
Even a madman like Lan Tian couldn’t hold back anymore. He asked with astonishment, “Just how many carrier treasures do you have?”

“I only have a few of them. About twenty.” Su Yu smiled, “It’s not much. I also have six heaven weapons. Altogether, there are only 26 such treasures. At the moment, I have 301 pages. That’s not even enough to upgrade one-tenth of my book. I previously fused a treasure and split the power equally throughout the entire book. After this, my book would have consumed 27 such treasures in total.”
“Madman.” Lan Tian said, “When I talked about ten thousand carrier treasures, I wasn’t being serious. But you…you’re actually trying to do it! What a lunatic!”
Unlike him, Su Yu wasn’t all talk and no action.
How crazy.
He suddenly felt normal. Because Su Yu was the real madman here.
He must be crazy.
He must be sick.
Lan Tian was very honest with himself. He had never expected to get ten thousand carrier treasures before. Those were mere empty talks. Meanwhile, Su Yu was doing it for real. Had he gone crazy?

Su Yu was completely indifferent as he said, “What are you saying, Senior. Since I wish to do it, I’ll naturally do it. As a cultural researcher, I should always be pursuing the unknown and exploring the future. Who knows what will happen in the future? In any case, I don’t need these treasures. My teacher and the others don’t need them yet.

“By the time they need carrier treasures, I won’t lack carrier treasures either. The entire Myriad Realms are filled with people after my life. I am not destined for a life of peace. I will fight endlessly. I won’t lack carrier treasures.”

He was certain about that. The Myriad Realms would only achieve peace upon his death or his victory over the Myriad Realms. He had grown into a tyrant feared by the Myriad Realms. He had a powerful faction behind him. Unknowingly, he had gathered a large number of Invincibles under his banner.
Thus, it wouldn’t be wrong to call him one of the overlords of the Myriad Realms. He was an independent overlord, separate from the divines, devils, immortals, humans, and dragons.

“When those outside learn of all that has happened here…” Su Yu grinned, “Do you think I have any other path to walk? Those geezers might even join hands to eliminate the ancient cities just to kill me.”

“Therefore, I need to grow strong.” Su Yu’s eyes turned cold as he said, “I won’t allow them to trap me in the city again and again. A day will come when I become the one to go after them. I will be collecting all their corpses. Every last one of them.”
At that moment, his Mark of Civilization trembled slightly.
Suddenly, Su Yu grinned again, “There is no rush. The corpses of the myriad races are waiting for us. If Su Yu wants him to die at three, he won’t survive to see five.”

The Mark of Civilization shook again before calming down. Next, Su Yu started shattering his heaven weapons and carrier treasures. Previously, he was too weak to do this himself. Now, he was strong enough. With the help of Yun Chen and Lan Tian, it didn’t take him long to finish the job.

The divine, devil, immortal, dragon, and nether pages had all been fused with carrier treasures. He had discovered that these races had too many experts. Their pages needed to be strong enough to store so many corpses.

One after another, the pages started advancing. Before long, about twenty pages reached the peak of the earth grade. The projections inside these pages had also grown significantly stronger. The immortal page, in particular, had produced a seventh-stage Sunmoon projection. How terrifying.

The Mark of Civilization as a whole was also advancing. By the time Su Yu was gasping for breath, the Mark of Civilization had reached 126 golden stripes. With a rumble, the 127th stripe appeared, pushing it into a high-tier heaven weapon.

The Mark of Civilization had grown into a terrifyingly powerful weapon. It had surpassed even the weapons of some ancient fossils out there. With the advancement of the book, the two characters on the book had also grown.

Finally, only one drop of Invincible blood essence was left. This was the blood essence he had obtained from an ancient race Invincible. It was the blood essence of someone alive. He was in no rush to use it. He had other uses for it.

When encountering that Invincible again in the future, he could perhaps destroy the blood essence to deal a minor backlash on that Invincible. He could then take the chance to kill the said Invincible.
“How strong.”

With a sigh, the clothes on his body vanished before being replaced by white robes. With the book in hand, his hair started fluttering about gently. At the same time, a saintly aura rippled out of his body.
Facing Yun Chen and the others, he cupped his fists and flashed them a gentle smile, “Fellow Daoists, thank you.”

Yun Chen and Lan Tian both felt like they were looking at their closest friend. But after a short moment, their hearts chilled. They trembled as they stared at him in shock. They had a feeling the world would no longer see peace. This lunatic…looked too normal. He looked so normal that anyone would have the urge to talk about their dreams and future with him.
“Su Yu!” Lan Tian said grudgingly, “Can…can you teach me to be abnormal enough that everyone thinks I’m normal?”
Yes. He was seeking Su Yu’s guidance. He was in need of such an ability. He had lived a life of rejection because he was too crazy. How to be so crazy that he looked normal?
For the first time, Lan Tian felt insecure in his madness. He had thought that he couldn’t fit in with the masses because of his madness. But now, he knew that he was simply not mad enough.
With the same gentle smile, Su Yu said, “You jest, Fellow Daoist Lan Tian. A learned and well-mannered scholar is naturally someone everyone wishes to approach. Just read more. It will be helpful.”

Then, he flipped his book open and stopped at the immortal page. On it, he started writing: An immortal known as Xuan He. A fifth-degree Eternal. Good at divination… He wrote Xuan He’s epitaph with a pious and saintly expression.
While writing, he muttered, “No, I still lack something. Yes, I lack a pen. As a learned man, it is too barbaric to write with my finger. I need a divine pen.”
Madman!

Once again, Lan Tian roared inwardly. This was a total madman! No, that wasn’t the point. More importantly, why did he get the urge to know Su Yu better, even when Su Yu was simply standing there writing? How terrifying.
